description.zh: 用 ffmpeg 处理视频，让它符合后台模型对时长/大小的要求：probe=探测时长/分辨率/大小；split=按时长切成片段（给 segment_seconds，或给 max_mb 自动算每段时长；流复制按关键帧对齐，段长为近似值）；compress=压缩到目标大小（max_mb 必填，可限 max_height，需精确控制大小时用这个）；frames=均匀抽帧成图片（视觉模型只收图片时用）。产物落在项目工作目录。
description.en: Process a video with ffmpeg so it satisfies the backend model's duration/size limits: probe = duration/resolution/size; split = cut into time segments (give segment_seconds, or max_mb to auto-derive; stream-copy aligns to keyframes so lengths are approximate); compress = shrink to a target size (max_mb required, optional max_height — use this when the size must be exact); frames = extract evenly spaced frames as images (for vision models that only take images). Outputs land in the project workspace.

path.description: 视频文件路径（工作目录内或已引用的文件）

segment_seconds.description: split：每段时长（秒），不填且给了 max_mb 时自动计算

max_mb.description: 目标大小上限（MB）：compress 必填；split 时用于自动算每段时长

path.description: video file path (inside the workspace or a referenced file)

segment_seconds.description: split: seconds per segment; auto-derived when omitted and max_mb is given

max_mb.description: target size cap in MB: required for compress; for split it derives the segment length

frame_count.description: frames: number of frames to extract (default 8)
